decisions: DEFAULT TAKEN, owner said 'go with this order': create_workspace, transfer and persona writes call Supabase directly and online for now, because the sync engine (007) and the command endpoints (017) do not exist; the calls live in features/workspace/utils/workspace-remote.ts, the only file in the context that talks to Supabase (through shared/lib/supabase.ts). 007/017 turn them into outbox rpc ops without changing any reader.
ANSWERED, owner: the creator is the leader at creation; 'picking a leader' is transfer_leadership to an existing member.

ANSWERED, owner: teams, roster, session and personas are pulled once into Dexie meta (DB-Q12) with putMeta (new entities/repository/meta-repository.ts, the only Dexie access outside db/queries/repository); 007's engine replaces the pull.

The workspace slice is one slice named `workspace` (profile id, team id, session id, mode, ui.error); the action names workspaceOpened and modeChanged match the blueprint's listener list. Only ids are stored (I11); the store edit whitelisted it (I12) and ui is stripped (I16).

BUG FOUND BY THE REAL-CHROME PASS AND FIXED AT THE SEAM: stripUi persists a slice without `ui`, and redux-persist's default reconciler replaced the whole slice on rehydrate, so state.workspace.ui was undefined and a reload crashed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)'. persist.ts now uses autoMergeLevel2 (each persisted slice merges into its initial state), which fixes it for every future slice. A regression test in store.test.ts turns red without the line (mutation-checked). This closes the 'first slice must add a rehydration test' item 005 left in not_covered.
No /auth route: AuthGuard shows the sign-in form in place on /w and /w/[id], so a separate page adds nothing today (the plan doc's §4 lists it). Add it if a distinct sign-in URL is wanted.
The mode switch changes the persisted slice only; it does not write sessions.default_mode (a later task decides where the mode lives on the server).
Sign-out deletes the profile's Dexie database (F6). ponytail: safe now because nothing is unsynced; once 007's outbox exists it must warn or refuse while ops are queued.
